reuse.why: Changes the rule inside the existing shared getExpectedScheduleAmount used by forecast, schedule actions, posting and preview; it keeps the inline 0.075 threshold rather than using the existing getApproxNumberThreshold.

duplication.why: The diff adds no new copies, but it leaves api-models.ts's own furthest-from-zero expectedAmount copy in place, now disagreeing with the shared rule.

placement.why: The rule change lands in shared/schedules.ts, the single definition its consumers already call.

scope.why: A two-line rule change plus updated comments and tests; the only extra is a test reformat.

maintainability.why: Simple and centralised, though the untouched copy in api-models.ts is a lurking inconsistency.
